selection: Among validation-qualified candidates only, maximum .35accuracy+.65macroF1 with no lower seven metrics than the same deployed baseline raw validation. If none qualifies, no test access.
test: Freeze one selected candidate, evaluate once using strict-all-metrics, never try the other candidate after seeing test.
declaration: Added after two deep-supervision validation epochs; exploratory selection on reused validation, not an independent fresh protocol. Third longer self-distillation continuation added after negative auxiliary/capacity/foreign-teacher validation outcomes; before any new test access. Foreign teacher rejected and never used for FusDenseNet training. Fourth/final SAM classifier-only comparison added during the conservative continuation, before test access.
